component.name: lpr
component.title: Printer
component.description: Send documents as print jobs to local or network printers by using the Java Print Service API.
component.label: document

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

PrinterJobName.label: producer
PrinterJobName.description: The name of the print job, sent to the print service as the JobName attribute. If not set, the job is named Camel: lpr.

producerIn.description: The document to print, read as a stream: text, bytes, a stream or a file, in the format of the mimeType and flavor options. A Map, a POJO, a number or no body fails with an InvalidPayloadException

hostname.description: The host name of the printer. With localhost, the producer looks up a printer of this machine by printername alone, or uses the default printer of this machine when printername is default. With another host, it looks up the printer by hostname/printername.

port.description: The port of the printer. The producer does not use it, as it looks up the printer by name. It is only part of the service location of the endpoint.

printername.description: The name of the printer, for example default or sales/salesprinter, as the print services of this machine (javax.print.PrintServiceLookup) know it, so a remote printer must be installed on this machine. A print service matches when its name ends with the looked-up name or the other way round, ignoring case and treating / and \ alike. The producer fails to start when no print service matches.

copies.description: The number of copies to print, sent as the Copies attribute of the print request. The producer fails to start when the value is less than 1.

docFlavor.description: The doc flavor as a javax.print.DocFlavor, for example a reference to a bean. When set, it replaces the doc flavor that the flavor and mimeType options select.

flavor.description: The representation class of the doc flavor, as the name of a nested class of javax.print.DocFlavor: DocFlavor.BYTE_ARRAY, DocFlavor.INPUT_STREAM or DocFlavor.URL, and for the mimeType TEXT_HTML or TEXT_PLAIN DocFlavor.CHAR_ARRAY, DocFlavor.READER or DocFlavor.STRING. If not set, DocFlavor.BYTE_ARRAY is used. Together with mimeType it selects the doc flavor, and an unknown value or a combination that names no doc flavor fails the creation of the endpoint.

mediaSize.description: The paper size, as the name that javax.print.attribute.standard.MediaSizeName gives it, for example na-letter, na-legal, iso-a4 or japanese-postcard. Case is ignored and _ may be used for -, so ISO_A4 works too. An unknown size fails the creation of the endpoint.

mediaTray.description: The name of the input tray to take the paper from, as javax.print.attribute.standard.MediaTray gives it with spaces replaced by _, for example top, middle, bottom or manual. The name must match, with the same case, a tray that the printer reports, or the producer fails to start.

mimeType.description: The format of the document, as the name of a doc flavor constant of javax.print.DocFlavor, for example AUTOSENSE, PDF, POSTSCRIPT, PCL, GIF, JPEG, TEXT_PLAIN_UTF_8 or TEXT_HTML. If not set, AUTOSENSE is used, which lets the print service detect the format. With sendToPrinter set to false, it also selects the extension of the written file.

orientation.description: The orientation of the printed pages, as a value of javax.print.attribute.standard.OrientationRequested.

printerPrefix.description: A text that the producer puts before hostname/printername to form the name of the printer to look up. It is not used when the host is localhost.

sendToPrinter.description: Whether to send the print job to the printer. If false, the producer writes the document to a file named PrintOutput_ followed by a random UUID in the target directory of the working directory, with the extension gif, jpeg, pdf or txt that matches mimeType. The producer still looks up the printer when it starts, and the printer must support the doc flavor.

sides.description: Whether to print on one side or on both sides of the paper, as a value of javax.print.attribute.standard.Sides. The value duplex is the same as two-sided-long-edge, and tumble the same as two-sided-short-edge.
